//minimumDependencyAge: Deno 2.9 refuses any JSR/npm version younger than 24h. That default is
right for third-party code and stays in force — the exclude list names ONE
package rather than disabling the setting.
@cfs/core is first-party: we publish it from chicago-film-supplies/core and
the workspace publish order (edit core/beta -> publish -> bump these pins)
means every core change reaches this repo minutes old by construction.
Without the exclusion a `deno install` here fails outright for a full day
after each publish, which is what it did on the beta.117 bump.
Same setting, same reasoning, as api-cloudrun/deno.json — do NOT widen it
to a bare age override: the 24h window is the only supply-chain delay we
get on a compromised third-party publish.
